raw.en: Gibberellin is (A) a phytohormone (B) an enzyme (C) carbohydrate (D) fat | 48. Wilting of leaves is due to which phytohormone ? (A) Ethylene (B) Abscisic acid (C) Cytokinin (D) Auxin | 49. Out of a combination of resistors, one resistor is removed and it is found that the net resistance has increased. The resistor was connected in (A) parallel (B) series (C) cannot be said (D) none of these

notes: Continues Q47 English options (answer (A) a phytohormone), Q48 Biology (last of this Biology block). Q49 switches to Physics (resistors in series/parallel), answer (B) series.
